title: Ely Outfitting Company
specs: Licensed guides who are experienced outdoor educators and anglers
Ultralight canoes and top-notch camping equipment provided for guided trips
All transportation services require at least one canoe rental
RABC permit required for Quetico entry via remote southern Ranger Stations; must carry permit on trail
BWCAW quota entry permit required for overnight trips May 1 through September 30
Lifejacket for each person required in Quetico
Guided day trips: groups up to 8 guests; pricing for up to 2 or 4 guests with additional guests $50 each
BWCAW entry permits valid for groups up to 9 people and up to 4 watercraft

options.name: Ground Shuttles
options.detail: Transport guests and canoes between Ely and BWCAW entry points with options to leave personal vehicle in town or do a chase shuttle.

options.detail: Scenic day canoe trips with guide, canoes, paddles, and life vests included; itinerary customized to preferences.
